scripts.test: go test ./... && (cd desktop/gui && go test ./...) && node desktop/gui/frontend/tests/tls_status.test.js
scripts.test:offline: go test ./... && (cd desktop/gui && go test ./...) && node desktop/gui/frontend/tests/tls_status.test.js && (cd cloudflare/eqt-drm-api && npm run test:offline)
scripts.test:all: go test ./... && (cd desktop/gui && go test ./...) && node desktop/gui/frontend/tests/tls_status.test.js && (cd cloudflare/eqt-drm-api && npm run test:offline) && node scripts/build-i18n-website.js
scripts.publish:all: npm run test:all && npm run publish:test && npm run publish:prod
scripts.deploy:test: bash -c 'WRANGLER_ENV="env -u http_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u all_proxy -u ALL_PROXY CI=true" && cd cloudflare/eqt-drm-api && $WRANGLER_ENV npx wrangler deploy --env test && cd ../eqt-feedback-api && $WRANGLER_ENV npx wrangler deploy --env test && cd ../.. && npm run website:build && cd cloudflare/eqt-website && $WRANGLER_ENV npx wrangler pages deploy ./ --project-name=eqt-test --branch=dev'
scripts.deploy:prod: bash -c 'WRANGLER_ENV="env -u http_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u all_proxy -u ALL_PROXY CI=true" && cd cloudflare/eqt-drm-api && $WRANGLER_ENV npx wrangler deploy && cd ../eqt-feedback-api && $WRANGLER_ENV npx wrangler deploy && cd ../.. && npm run website:build && cd cloudflare/eqt-website && $WRANGLER_ENV npx wrangler pages deploy ./ --project-name=eqt --branch=master'
scripts.deploy:admin: bash -c 'WRANGLER_ENV="env -u http_proxy -u HTTP_PROXY -u https_proxy -u HTTPS_PROXY -u all_proxy -u ALL_PROXY CI=true" && cd cloudflare/eqt-admin && npm run build && $WRANGLER_ENV npx wrangler pages deploy dist --project-name=eqt-admin --branch=master'
